stem.text: A variable force is applied to ensure that a constant power is supplied to a train.
Which graph best shows the variation of the force $F$ applied with the velocity $v$ of the train?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis v, origin marked 0. A curve starts near the upper left of the vertical axis and falls towards the horizontal axis.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis v, origin marked 0. A straight line rises from the origin.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis v, origin marked 0. A curve rises from the origin and levels off towards the right.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis v, origin marked 0. A curve rises from the origin and steepens towards the upper right.
